title: Polynomial-time unary replication
statement: For every $k\in\mathbb N$ and every polynomial-time computable function $g\colon\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^*$, the function sending $y$ to the string of $k|g(y)|$ ones is polynomial-time computable.
